description: Local patched Rust source is integrated into the Aphrody Cargo workspace. Reference upstreams are read live; build-only checkouts are restored on demand.
rootNote: Used only for optional build-on-demand upstream inputs. Cargo no longer requires a sibling source directory.

reference.purpose: Prebuilt CPython 3.12.15 (default, the py workspace baseline) and 3.14.8 distributions (install_only_stripped and full archives) that the vu runtime embeds; consumed as release assets pinned by sha256, not forked.

integrated.note: Registry archive, not a Git clone. Preserve Tauri 3/security patches until an equivalent upstream release. Rust/JS/build/license files match the previous pinned Git tree before patching.

crates.io 0.1.7 archive (src, build.rs, LICENSE, NOTICE, README). pixel_formats_equal used a bitwise NOT on a u8 (!flag != 0 is always true), so every 32 bpp true-colour client format was treated as the server rgba32 and never translated: BGRA viewers saw red and blue swapped. Fixture tests and the generate_fixture binary are not integrated. Drop once upstream ships the fix.
crates.io 0.7.0 archive, as extracted before the move. The patch gives the bundled C++ a private namespace so it does not collide with V8's own simdutf in the same process.
Vendored at plugins-workspace dialog 3.0.0-alpha.3, which imports Manager upstream (patch dropped 2026-10-09).

ML base crates of Koharu 0.83.5 (tag 0.83.5, commit 52bb4f55e2266f72c1523562a583c827ec191ceb) (bindgen, config, runtime, llama, llama-sys, torch, torch-sys, diffusion, diffusion-sys) integrated under crates/ml as aphrody-* packages: crates.io holds older koharu-* releases under the upstream names. Divergence from the tag is not yet audited, so no patch is recorded. On-disk contracts kept: ~/.koharu/config.toml, the `koharu` runtime store and the libkoharu-torch shim of koharu-rs/torch releases. The Koharu product crates live in aphrody-labs/shenron.

Obscura headless browser crates copied under crates/web. Base: upstream main 1fccab2c1ecd0f7eadc16d7a520ba227f9e7f782 (2026-10-04), synced through 1f8eb7643 (2026-10-08) and then 2bda71a557247bd2d6fabf01fa66eb4b07dcb2e8 (2026-10-10) by a three-way merge on 2026-10-11. The upstream merge is published in aphrody-labs/obscura yolo commit 0c6fe8c0bc3f1a717349e207a407666e97d0bb98, first parent 41b0d90953aa27fdc5c72d84dd17cc1fb82a4519. Installed obscura CLI remains sourced from the fork. Local adaptations are retained in the integrated source and described in docs/reference/web/crates/aphrody-obscura/OBSCURA-UPSTREAM.txt. vendor/taffy remains aphrody-labs/taffy and cosmic-text resolves to athena-text from crates.io.

Layout fork carrying the upstream Obscura layout changes. Integrated from the pinned revision (src, Cargo.toml, LICENSE, README, MIGRATION.json) as the aphrody-taffy package (library name taffy, published on crates.io) so a build needs no SSH alias to the private repository (cloud sessions, CI, factory). Local patch: TaffyTree::remove releases measured-node context data and invalidates the parent layout cache; LOCAL-PATCHES.md and MIGRATION.json retain the patch and regression fixture. Preserve this patch or qualify its upstream replacement when re-importing the fork revision. Subsequent retained-node removal patch and regression are recorded in crates/ui/taffy/LOCAL-PATCHES.md and MIGRATION.json; native and cross-target source qualification is recorded in docs/operations/workspace/taffy-integration-2026-10-07.md.
